dispatch.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Start WORKFLOW (default image.yml, or deploy.yml) for the revision this
# ci.yml run is checking. Called as the last ci.yml steps on main, after the
# release is retained, so the dispatched job never holds a builder slot while
# the checks run; it still confirms this run succeeded and skips itself if
# the run fails or is cancelled.
set -euo pipefail

workflow=${1:-image.yml}
[[ $workflow == image.yml || $workflow == deploy.yml ]] || { echo "usage: $0 [image.yml|deploy.yml]" >&2; exit 2; }

: "${GH_TOKEN:?GitHub Actions token is required}"
export GH_HOST=github.com
[[ ${GITHUB_SHA:-} =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo 'GitHub source SHA is required' >&2; exit 1; }
[[ ${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-} =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$ && ${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER:-} =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$ ]] || { echo 'GitHub CI run identity is required' >&2; exit 1; }
[[ ${GITHUB_REF:-} == refs/heads/main ]] || { echo "only main revisions start $workflow automatically" >&2; exit 1; }

# An image is rebuilt only when its inputs change, and weekly (the schedule)
# so base and package updates still land.
if [[ $workflow == image.yml && ${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:-} != schedule ]]; then
	status=0
	bash "$(dirname -- "$0")/image-inputs-changed.sh" || status=$?
	if ((status == 3)); then
		echo "image.yml not dispatched for $GITHUB_SHA"
		exit 0
	fi
fi

gh api --method POST "repos/TerraScale/ts-orchestrator/actions/workflows/$workflow/dispatches" \
	-f ref=main -f "inputs[source_revision]=$GITHUB_SHA" \
	-f "inputs[source_ci_run_id]=$GITHUB_RUN_ID" -f "inputs[source_ci_run_number]=$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" \
	-f 'inputs[trigger]=ci'
echo "$workflow dispatched for $GITHUB_SHA"

changed.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Decide whether GITHUB_SHA needs a new host image. Exit 3 when every image
# input is unchanged since the source of the newest image release. Any other
# status builds: a changed input, no image release, a failed comparison or a
# failure of this script itself. Orchestrator code alone never needs an image: running nodes
# take new binaries through self-update, and a new node updates after its
# first boot.
#
# The base is the newest image release, not this push's parent: a newer
# push cancels a running ci.yml check, and a change the cancelled run carried
# must still produce an image.
set -euo pipefail
unchanged=3

# Everything an image bakes in besides the binary: the pinned base and
# inputs, the units and udev rules it installs, and the code that builds it.
inputs=(deploy/image deploy/systemd deploy/udev internal/image internal/netbird/client .github/workflows/image.yml
	go.mod go.sum scripts/ci/image-inputs-changed.sh)

# Follow the image tool's imports, including helpers that render baked files.
# Package source globs retain deleted, generated and other-platform inputs;
# embed prefixes retain removed files that no longer appear in EmbedFiles.
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
graph=
for architecture in amd64 arm64; do
	if ! platform_graph=$(GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOOS=linux GOARCH=$architecture \
		go list -mod=readonly -deps -json ./internal/image ./internal/netbird/client); then
		echo 'image tool dependencies are unreadable; building the image' >&2
		exit 0
	fi
	graph+=$'\n'"$platform_graph"
done
if ! dependencies=$(jq -rs --arg root "$root/" '
	[.[] | select(.Dir | startswith($root)) |
	 (.Dir | ltrimstr($root)) as $dir |
	 (["go", "s", "S", "h", "c", "cc", "cpp", "m", "mm", "syso"][] |
	   ":(glob)" + $dir + "/*." + .),
	 ((.EmbedPatterns // [])[] | sub("^all:"; "") | sub("[*?\\[].*$"; "") |
	   sub("/+$"; "") | ":(literal)" + $dir + "/" + .),
	 (.Module.GoMod // empty | select(startswith($root)) |
	   ltrimstr($root) | ":(literal)" + .)] |
	if length == 0 or any(test("[\\r\\n]")) then error("invalid image dependencies") else .[] end
' <<< "$graph"); then
	echo 'image tool dependency paths are unreadable; building the image' >&2
	exit 0
fi
while IFS= read -r dependency; do inputs+=("$dependency"); done <<< "$dependencies"
inputs+=(':(exclude,glob)**/*_test.go')

if ! pins=$(jq -er '
	[.. | objects | .path? | strings] |
	if length == 0 or any(. == "" or startswith("/") or
	   test("(^|/)\\.\\.(/|$)|[\\r\\n]")) then error("invalid image file pins") else .[] end
' deploy/image/image-inputs.json); then
	echo 'image file pins are unreadable; building the image' >&2
	exit 0
fi
while IFS= read -r pin; do inputs+=(":(literal)$pin"); done <<< "$pins"

: "${GH_TOKEN:?GitHub Actions token is required}"
export GH_HOST=github.com
[[ ${GITHUB_SHA:-} =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo 'GitHub source SHA is required' >&2; exit 0; }
repository=TerraScale/ts-orchestrator

# Releases list newest first; ci-<sha> releases outnumber image releases.
base=
page_size=50
for page in {1..10}; do
	if ! releases=$(timeout 30 gh api "repos/$repository/releases?per_page=$page_size&page=$page"); then
		echo 'image releases are unreadable; building the image' >&2
		exit 0
	fi
	base=$(jq -r 'first(.[] | select(.draft == false and
		any(.assets[]?; .name == "image-qualification.json")) |
		.tag_name | capture("^image-(?<sha>[0-9a-f]{40})-run-").sha) // empty' <<< "$releases" 2>/dev/null) || base=
	[[ -n $base ]] && break
	[[ $(jq -r 'length' <<< "$releases" 2>/dev/null) == "$page_size" ]] || break
done
[[ -n $base ]] || { echo 'no image release found; building the image'; exit 0; }

# Both trees are fetched one level deep; diffing two trees needs no history.
auth=$(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$GH_TOKEN" | base64 -w 0)
if ! GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=http.extraHeader GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="AUTHORIZATION: basic $auth" \
	timeout 120 git fetch --quiet --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$base"; then
	echo "image release source $base is unreadable; building the image" >&2
	exit 0
fi
status=0
git diff --quiet "$base" "$GITHUB_SHA" -- "${inputs[@]}" || status=$?
case $status in
	0) echo "image inputs are unchanged since the image of $base"; exit "$unchanged" ;;
	1) echo "image inputs changed since the image of $base:"
	   git diff --name-only "$base" "$GITHUB_SHA" -- "${inputs[@]}" || true ;;
	*) echo "comparing with the image of $base failed; building the image" >&2 ;;
esac

gate.text:
source_sha=${1:-}
ci_run_id=${2:-}
ci_run_number=${3:-}
wait_seconds=${4:-6000}
[[ $source_sha =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ && $ci_run_id =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$ &&
	$ci_run_number =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$ && $wait_seconds =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{0,5}$ && $# -le 4 ]] || {
	echo "usage: $0 SOURCE_SHA CI_RUN_ID CI_RUN_NUMBER [WAIT_SECONDS]" >&2
	exit 2
}
export GH_TOKEN=${GH_TOKEN:-${GH_READ_TOKEN:-}}
: "${GH_TOKEN:?GitHub read token is required}"
export GH_HOST=github.com
: "${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?GITHUB_OUTPUT is required}"
workflow=${GATE_WORKFLOW:-image.yml}

deadline=$((SECONDS + wait_seconds))
api_get() {
	local remaining=$((deadline - SECONDS))
	((remaining > 0)) || return 1
	((remaining <= 30)) || remaining=30
	timeout "$remaining" gh api "$@"
}
wait_again() {
	local remaining=$((deadline - SECONDS))
	((remaining > 0)) || {
		echo "CI gate timed out for $source_sha (run $ci_run_id, status $status); dispatch $workflow manually after ci.yml succeeds" >&2
		exit 1
	}
	((remaining <= 10)) || remaining=10
	sleep "$remaining"
}

while :; do
	if ! status=$(api_get "repos/TerraScale/ts-orchestrator/actions/runs/$ci_run_id" |
		jq -r --arg id "$ci_run_id" --arg number "$ci_run_number" --arg source "$source_sha" '
		  if (.id | tostring) == $id and (.run_number | tostring) == $number and
		    .path == ".github/workflows/ci.yml" and .head_branch == "main" and .head_sha == $source then
		    if .status == "completed" then .conclusion else .status end
		  else "absent" end'); then
		status=poll-failed
		echo "actions run poll failed; retrying run $ci_run_id" >&2
	fi
	case $status in
		success) break ;;
		failure|cancelled)
			echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
			echo "$workflow for $source_sha skipped: dispatching ci.yml run $ci_run_id ended $status"
			exit 0 ;;
		action_required|skipped|timed_out|neutral|stale|startup_failure)
			echo "dispatching ci.yml run $ci_run_id is $status; dispatch $workflow manually after ci.yml succeeds" >&2
			exit 1 ;;
	esac
	wait_again
done

# A repeated run of this SHA cannot replace the dispatching run's identity.
# Retry supersession reads within the same budget instead of losing a
# qualified image on a transient Actions API failure.
while :; do
	if candidates=$(api_get --paginate --slurp "repos/TerraScale/ts-orchestrator/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?branch=main&status=success&per_page=100" |
		jq -c '[.[].workflow_runs[] | select(.path == ".github/workflows/ci.yml" and
		  .head_branch == "main" and .event != "pull_request" and .status == "completed" and
		  .conclusion == "success")] | sort_by(.id) | reverse | .[]'); then
		break
	fi
	status=supersession-poll-failed
	echo "qualified run poll failed; retrying" >&2
	wait_again
done
latest='{}'
# A successful docs-only check has no retained runtime candidate and cannot
# supersede the older executable/image candidate still waiting for delivery.
while IFS= read -r candidate; do
	[[ -n $candidate ]] || continue
	latest_id=$(jq -r .id <<< "$candidate")
	((latest_id > ci_run_id)) || break
	latest_source=$(jq -er '.head_sha | select(test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$"))' <<< "$candidate")
	tag=ci-$latest_source-run-$latest_id
	if release=$(api_get "repos/TerraScale/ts-orchestrator/releases/tags/$tag") &&
		jq -e --arg tag "$tag" '(.assets | map(.name)) as $assets |
		  .tag_name == $tag and .draft == false and .prerelease == true and
		  all(["qualification.json", "terrascale-orchestrator-linux-amd64",
		    "terrascale-orchestrator-linux-arm64"][]; . as $name |
		    [$assets[] | select(. == $name)] | length == 1)' <<< "$release" >/dev/null; then
		latest=$candidate
		break
	fi
done <<< "$candidates"
latest_id=$(jq -r '.id // 0' <<< "$latest")
if ((latest_id > ci_run_id)) && [[ $(jq -r .head_sha <<< "$latest") != "$source_sha" ]]; then
	echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
	echo "$workflow for $source_sha skipped: $(jq -r .head_sha <<< "$latest") passed ci.yml later (run $latest_id) and runs next"
else
	echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
	echo "$workflow for $source_sha qualified by dispatching ci.yml run $ci_run_id"
fi

qualify.text:
set -euo pipefail

# GO may be a command with arguments, such as "mise exec -- go".
read -r -a go <<< "${GO:-go}"
# A multi-line repository variable must not silently drop every suite after
# its first line: read the whole value (read -d '' returns 1 at EOF).
read -r -d '' -a suites <<< "${TS_QUALIFICATION_SUITES:-}" || true
budget=600
((${#suites[@]})) || { echo 'TS_QUALIFICATION_SUITES names no qualification suite' >&2; exit 2; }
declare -A packages=(
	[terrabase-walkthrough]=./internal/app
	[terrabase-successor]=./internal/managedmaterial
	[native-validator]=./internal/managedmaterial
	[rendered-sfo-enrollment]=./internal/app
	[terrabase-binary]=./internal/terrabase
	[terrabase-release]=./internal/app
	[ts-auth-terrabase]=./internal/tsauth
)
declare -A tests=(
	[terrabase-walkthrough]='^TestTerraBaseWalkthroughAgainstRealMembers$'
	[terrabase-successor]='^TestProduceSuccessorRustInterop$'
	[native-validator]='^TestPrepareInitialUsesAdmittedPackagedNativeValidator$'
	[rendered-sfo-enrollment]='^TestManagedPlacementEnrollmentFromRenderedSFOBundle$'
	[terrabase-binary]='^TestTerraBaseBinaryPeerMesh$'
	[terrabase-release]='^TestTerraBaseReleaseDeployUpgradeRollback$'
	[ts-auth-terrabase]='^TestBootstrapAgainstTerraBaseRelease$'
)
for suite in "${suites[@]}"; do
	[[ -n ${packages[$suite]:-} ]] || { echo "unknown qualification suite: $suite" >&2; exit 2; }
done

export TS_TEST_TIER=qualification
logs=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/qualify-image.XXXXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf -- "$logs"' EXIT
failed=0
deadline=$((SECONDS + budget))
for suite in "${suites[@]}"; do
	remaining=$((deadline - SECONDS))
	if ((remaining <= 0)); then
		echo "qualification suite $suite did not run: the ${budget}s qualification budget is spent" >&2
		failed=1
		continue
	fi
	status=0
	timeout --kill-after=5s "${remaining}s" "${go[@]}" test -count=1 -v -timeout="${remaining}s" -run "${tests[$suite]}" "${packages[$suite]}" > "$logs/$suite.log" 2>&1 || status=$?
	cat "$logs/$suite.log"
	if ((status != 0)); then
		echo "qualification suite $suite failed" >&2
		failed=1
	elif grep -q -E '^[[:space:]]*--- SKIP: ' "$logs/$suite.log"; then
		echo "qualification suite $suite skipped a test; its fixture is incomplete" >&2
		failed=1
	elif ! grep -q -E '^--- PASS: ' "$logs/$suite.log"; then
		echo "qualification suite $suite ran no test" >&2
		failed=1
	else
		echo "qualification suite $suite passed"
	fi
done
exit "$failed"

workflow_ci.text:
# Go's test cache keys the repository files a test reads on size and
      # modification time. Content-derived times let tests whose inputs did
      # not change hit the persistent cache after this fresh checkout.
      - name: Install shell validation tools
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck

      - name: Stamp tracked files with content-derived times
        shell: bash
        run: go run ./scripts/ci/stablemtime

      - name: Check and test every revision
        shell: bash
        run: make ci-check GO=go GOFMT=gofmt

      - name: Compare executable and image inputs with retained qualification
        id: inputs
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          status=0
          python3 -B scripts/ci/release-inputs-changed.py || status=$?
          case $status in
            0) echo 'publication=required' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;;
            3) echo 'publication=unchanged' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;;
            *) exit "$status" ;;
          esac

      - name: Build and verify this revision's static release binaries
        if: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.publication == 'required' }}
        shell: bash
        run: make --jobs=2 release-check GO=go

      - name: Retain verified binaries and qualification manifest
        if: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.publication == 'required' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_READ_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: bash scripts/ci/publish-qualification.sh


      # Deployment failure must not erase the time this build became qualified.
      - name: Record the qualified main build for the deployment-lag guard
        if: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.publication == 'required' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/statuses/${GITHUB_SHA}" \
            -f state=success -f context=deployment/qualified \
            -f description='Verified main build ready for automatic deployment'
      # Last, after the release is retained, so the image job never holds a
      # builder slot while it waits for these checks; it still confirms this
      # run succeeded and skips itself if it did not. The run's own result
      # never depends on it: a failed dispatch is visible here and is
      # repaired by dispatching image.yml for this revision by hand. Only a
      # change to an image input (scripts/ci/image-inputs-changed.sh) or the
      # weekly schedule starts a build.
      - name: Start the image build for this revision
        if: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.publication == 'required' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: bash scripts/ci/dispatch-image.sh

      # A newly retained candidate starts fleet deployment after verification.
      # Dispatch failure must be visible in CI.
      - name: Start the fleet deployment for this revision

workflow_wrapper.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Admission runs without OCI credentials. The deploy stage rechecks signed evidence.
# usage: deploy-fleet.sh qualify|deploy
set -euo pipefail
export GH_HOST=github.com
[[ $# == 1 && ($1 == qualify || $1 == deploy) ]] || { echo "usage: $0 qualify|deploy" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ ${SOURCE_SHA:-} =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ && ${SOURCE_CI_RUN_ID:-} =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$ ]] || {
    echo 'SOURCE_SHA and SOURCE_CI_RUN_ID must name the qualified run' >&2; exit 2;
}
[[ $(git rev-parse HEAD) == "$SOURCE_SHA" ]] || { echo 'checked-out source differs from the deployed revision' >&2; exit 1; }
umask 077
work=${RUNNER_TEMP:?RUNNER_TEMP is required}/production-$SOURCE_SHA-run-$SOURCE_CI_RUN_ID
root_key=$(jq -er '.trust_roots[0].path' deploy/image/image-inputs.json)
if [[ $1 == qualify ]]; then
    # A fresh admission directory cannot inherit previously qualified cells.
    [[ ! -e $work ]] || { echo 'admission directory already exists' >&2; exit 1; }
    mkdir -m 0700 "$work"
    mkdir "$work/release"
    tag=ci-$SOURCE_SHA-run-$SOURCE_CI_RUN_ID
    python3 -B scripts/ci/qualified_release.py "$SOURCE_SHA" "$SOURCE_CI_RUN_ID" "$work/release"
    bash scripts/ci/fetch-production-evidence.sh "$tag" "$work/release"
    # verify-production emits every serving region even when one is refused.
    admission_status=0
    "$work/release/terrascale-orchestrator-linux-amd64" release verify-production --dir "$work/release" --root-key "$root_key" \
        > "$work/production-admission.jsonl" || admission_status=$?
    cat "$work/production-admission.jsonl"
    jq -ers --arg source "$SOURCE_SHA" 'length > 0 and all(
        .schema == "terrascale.release.production-admission.v1" and .source_revision == $source and
        (.cell | test("^[A-Z]{3}$")) and (.state == "qualified" or .state == "refused")) and
        any(.state == "qualified")' "$work/production-admission.jsonl" >/dev/null || {
        echo "no serving region has exact retained production qualification (verifier exit $admission_status)" >&2; exit 1;
    }
    sha256sum "$work/release/qualification.json" "$work/release/terrascale-orchestrator-linux-"* \
        > "$work/qualification.sha256"
    exit 0
fi

[[ -f $work/qualification.sha256 && ! -L $work/qualification.sha256 ]] || { echo 'credential-free admission must complete first' >&2; exit 1; }
sha256sum --check --status "$work/qualification.sha256"
mapfile -t cells < <(jq -er 'select(.state == "qualified") | .cell' "$work/production-admission.jsonl")
((${#cells[@]})) || { echo 'no admitted regions' >&2; exit 1; }
arguments=()
for cell in "${cells[@]}"; do
    [[ $cell =~ ^[A-Z]{3}$ ]] || exit 2
    arguments+=(--cell "$cell")
done
# Recheck immediately before reading deployment credentials; deploy also checks
# the evidence for the complete rollout deadline before loading signing keys.
"$work/release/terrascale-orchestrator-linux-amd64" release verify-production --dir "$work/release" --root-key "$root_key" "${arguments[@]}"
for variable in TS_OBJECT_NAMESPACE TS_RELEASE_VAULT_ID TS_RELEASE_LEAF_SECRET TS_DEPLOY_OCI_USER \
    TS_DEPLOY_OCI_TENANCY TS_DEPLOY_OCI_FINGERPRINT TS_DEPLOY_OCI_KEY; do
    [[ -n ${!variable:-} ]] || { echo "$variable is required" >&2; exit 2; }
done
mkdir -m 0700 "$work/oci"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work/oci"' EXIT
printf '%s\n' "$TS_DEPLOY_OCI_KEY" > "$work/oci/key.pem"
unset TS_DEPLOY_OCI_KEY
printf '[DEFAULT]\nuser=%s\nfingerprint=%s\ntenancy=%s\nregion=sa-saopaulo-1\nkey_file=%s\n' \
    "$TS_DEPLOY_OCI_USER" "$TS_DEPLOY_OCI_FINGERPRINT" "$TS_DEPLOY_OCI_TENANCY" "$work/oci/key.pem" > "$work/oci/config"
export OCI_CONFIG_FILE=$work/oci/config
gh auth setup-git --hostname github.com
deploy_status=0
"$work/release/terrascale-orchestrator-linux-amd64" release deploy --dir "$work/release" --source-revision "$SOURCE_SHA" \
    --update-delegation-secret release-delegation --root-key "$root_key" \
    --signing-key-secret "$TS_RELEASE_LEAF_SECRET" --vault-id "$TS_RELEASE_VAULT_ID" \
    --source-checkout . --namespace "$TS_OBJECT_NAMESPACE" --poll 5s "${arguments[@]}" || deploy_status=$?
if jq -es 'any(.state == "refused")' "$work/production-admission.jsonl" >/dev/null; then
    echo 'fleet incomplete: qualified regions finished; refused regions were not deployed' >&2
    exit 1
fi
exit "$deploy_status"

controller_install_unit.text:
[Unit]
Description=Install root-signed TerraScale controller configuration
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target systemd-time-wait-sync.service
Requires=systemd-timesyncd.service systemd-time-wait-sync.service
Before=terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
# Units that Require this oneshot must see it active after it succeeds;
# otherwise each dependent start reruns it and trips the start limit.
RemainAfterExit=yes
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10s
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator install-controller-config
# A late success after a failed first boot must still start admission.
# OnSuccess= cannot: with RemainAfterExit the unit never goes inactive.
ExecStartPost=+/usr/bin/systemctl start --no-block terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap.service
# Admission failures also reach the serial console, readable before any SSH path is up.
StandardError=journal+console
TimeoutStartSec=120s
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
# CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH reads the adopted root chain in the controller's 0700 state
# directory (bootstrapstart.RootChainFile); root here has no other DAC bypass.
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_CHOWN CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH
AmbientCapabilities=
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/etc/terrascale-orchestrator
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
# The read-only kernel NTP health probe uses adjtimex(2); CAP_SYS_TIME is absent.
LockPersonality=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
SystemCallArchitectures=native
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=pid

bootstrap_unit.text:
[Unit]
Description=TerraScale Orchestrator controller bootstrap admission
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
Requires=systemd-timesyncd.service systemd-time-wait-sync.service
After=systemd-timesyncd.service systemd-time-wait-sync.service
Requires=terrascale-orchestrator-controller-install.service
After=terrascale-orchestrator-controller-install.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/terrascale-orchestrator/controller.json
Before=terrascale-orchestrator-controller.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
# The controller Requires this oneshot: without RemainAfterExit each
# controller start reruns admission in a loop.
RemainAfterExit=yes
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10s
# The credential directory is memory only: rebuild it from Vault first (TS-745).
ExecStartPre=+/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator restore-controller-material
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator bootstrap-controller --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/controller.json
# A boot's first admission can fail (the seed completion is not yet readable)
# and fail the controller's start job with it; the retry that succeeds must
# start the controller. OnSuccess= cannot: with RemainAfterExit the unit never
# goes inactive. "+" runs systemctl outside this unit's sandbox.
ExecStartPost=+/usr/bin/systemctl start --no-block terrascale-orchestrator-controller.service
# Admission failures also reach the serial console, readable before any SSH path is up.
StandardError=journal+console
TimeoutStartSec=300s
UMask=0077
RuntimeDirectory=terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
StateDirectory=terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap
StateDirectoryMode=0755
# Initial admission drops to the service account to preflight its
# credentials in a child process, so the unit runs as root by default:
# User=root with NoNewPrivileges=yes would make systemd drop CAP_SETUID.
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_CHOWN CAP_SETGID CAP_SETUID CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE CAP_KILL
AmbientCapabilities=
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap /var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator-secrets /var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator-controller /run/terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
# The read-only kernel NTP health probe uses adjtimex(2); CAP_SYS_TIME is absent.
LockPersonality=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
SystemCallArchitectures=native

host_unit.text:
[Unit]
Description=TerraScale Orchestrator host runtime
Wants=network-online.target
Requires=terrascale-orchestrator-host-setup.service
After=network-online.target terrascale-orchestrator-host-setup.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/terrascale-orchestrator/host.json
# Availability first: the restart backoff below reaches its 5min cap after
# seven starts (about 10 minutes), so at most about 17 starts fit in any hour
# and a loop at the capped backoff never reaches this burst; the host keeps
# retrying through a controller outage of any length. The limit only fails a
# runtime that restarts faster than that backoff (for example after a manual
# reset-failed), and the host-setup timer starts a failed runtime again.
StartLimitIntervalSec=1h
StartLimitBurst=20

[Service]
# READY=1 once the host is connected to its regional cell. No WatchdogSec=:
# restarting this process stops every supervised TerraBase member.
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
TimeoutStartSec=3min
# Runs as root by default: User=root with NoNewPrivileges=yes would make
# systemd drop CAP_SETUID, which the native workload helper needs.
SupplementaryGroups=
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator host --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/host.json
# Protect the host manager without throttling the managed database when idle.
# MemoryMin/MemoryLow come from the image profile; the native runner copies
# those floors to the supervisor subgroup.
CPUSchedulingPolicy=other
Nice=-20
CPUWeight=10000
IOWeight=10000
IOSchedulingClass=best-effort
IOSchedulingPriority=0
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
ManagedOOMPreference=omit
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
RestartSteps=6
RestartMaxDelaySec=5min
TimeoutStopSec=90s
KillSignal=SIGTERM
KillMode=control-group
LimitNOFILE=65536
LimitCORE=0
UMask=0077
StateDirectory=terrascale-orchestrator-host
StateDirectoryMode=0755
Delegate=yes
DelegateSubgroup=supervisor
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_CHOWN CAP_KILL CAP_SETGID CAP_SETUID CAP_SETPCAP CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH
AmbientCapabilities=
ProtectSystem=strict
# A custom root needs a drop-in that resets this list before adding its exact path.
ReadWritePaths=-/srv/ts-managed
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=no
ProtectHostname=yes
# The read-only kernel NTP health probe uses adjtimex(2); CAP_SYS_TIME is absent.
LockPersonality=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
SystemCallArchitectures=native

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
